readme:
# InternVL3 可变视觉位置增量

## 1. 问题

实现 `variable_visual_positions(visual: Tensor, image_ids: Tensor, deltas: Tensor) -> Tensor`。

每图像可变增量的位置递推、跨模态累计与梯度；原点明确固定为 -1，不实现完整旋转嵌入或 InternVL 训练。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
p_i=-1+\sum_{j=0}^{i}\left[(1-v_j)+v_j\delta_{\operatorname{image}(j)}\right].
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

递推依赖当前 token 的模态，等价于所有增量的前缀和再减一。同一图像使用同一个 delta，跨图像或文本边界都不能重置累计位置。delta 的梯度由该图像 token 在后续前缀中出现的次数决定。delta=1 应恢复普通 0 到 L-1 的位置；本题首 token 若是视觉，则位置是 delta-1，这是显式原点约定。

## 4. 本题约定

visual=[L] bool；image_ids=[L] int64，视觉位置给出 [0,M) 图像编号，文本位置使用 -1；deltas=[M] 浮点且 0<delta<=1。同一图像共享 delta。递推从 p_-1=-1 开始，当前 token 是文本则加 1，是视觉则加相应 delta。输出 [L] 与 deltas 同 dtype/device；允许空序列和 M=0 的纯文本，保留 delta 梯度。

CPU float32/float64；不得修改输入；仅接受有限浮点值。测试包含独立 oracle、边界、适用的梯度检查，以及被测函数参与的实验。

## 5. 交互图

确定性 CPU 实验调用被测函数；图表展示实际优化、检索或分组行为，请结合 metrics 阅读。合成实验不代表论文的完整基准结果。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

阅读下面来源的对应机制，再将独立核扩展到论文完整架构和数据管线。本题使用上面明确列出的可判题范围与教学简化。

# InternVL3 可变视觉位置增量 — 题解

递推依赖当前 token 的模态，等价于所有增量的前缀和再减一。同一图像使用同一个 delta，跨图像或文本边界都不能重置累计位置。delta 的梯度由该图像 token 在后续前缀中出现的次数决定。delta=1 应恢复普通 0 到 L-1 的位置；本题首 token 若是视觉，则位置是 delta-1，这是显式原点约定。

$$
p_i=-1+\sum_{j=0}^{i}\left[(1-v_j)+v_j\delta_{\operatorname{image}(j)}\right].
$$

参考实现按上述布局和归约逐步计算：

```python
def variable_visual_positions(visual: Tensor, image_ids: Tensor, deltas: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    _floating(deltas)
    if visual.ndim!=1 or visual.dtype!=torch.bool or image_ids.shape!=visual.shape or image_ids.dtype!=torch.long or deltas.ndim!=1 or (deltas<=0).any() or (deltas>1).any():
        raise ValueError("invalid masks, image IDs or deltas")
    if (image_ids[~visual]!=-1).any() or (image_ids[visual]<0).any() or (image_ids[visual]>=deltas.numel()).any():raise ValueError("invalid image assignment")
    increments=[]
    for is_visual,index in zip(visual.tolist(),image_ids.tolist()):
        increments.append(deltas[index] if is_visual else deltas.new_tensor(1.))
    if not increments:return deltas.new_empty((0,))
    return torch.stack(increments).cumsum(0)-1
```

错误实现检测覆盖这些常见问题：

- Uses ordinary integer positions for images
- Starts positions one unit too late

验证：T0 检查契约；T1 使用独立 oracle；T2 检查边界、不变量和有定义的梯度；T3 用被测函数运行确定性合成实验。完整输入、更新规则、步数和指标见 experiment.py，门限在 T3 测试中明确断言。

# InternVL3 variable visual position increments

## 1. Problem

Implement `variable_visual_positions(visual: Tensor, image_ids: Tensor, deltas: Tensor) -> Tensor`.

Per-image position increments, cumulative multimodal offsets, and gradients with an explicit origin of -1; exclude full rotary embeddings and InternVL training.

## 2. Core equations

$$
p_i=-1+\sum_{j=0}^{i}\left[(1-v_j)+v_j\delta_{\operatorname{image}(j)}\right].
$$

## 3. From equations to code

The recurrence depends on the current token’s modality and equals a prefix sum of increments minus one. Use one delta per image and never reset at image or text boundaries. Delta gradients count how many subsequent prefixes include each visual token. Delta one recovers positions 0 through L-1; a first visual token starts at delta-1 under the explicit origin.

## 4. Conventions

visual is boolean [L]; image_ids is int64 [L], using an image ID in [0,M) for visual tokens and -1 for text. deltas is floating [M] with 0<delta<=1. All tokens of an image share its delta. Start at p_-1=-1 and add 1 for the current text token or its image delta for the current visual token. Return [L] with deltas dtype/device. Empty sequences and text-only M=0 are valid; preserve delta gradients.

CPU float32/float64; no input mutation. Finite inputs only. Tests use scalar oracles, boundary cases, appropriate gradient checks, and a submitted-function experiment.

## 5. Interactive figure

The deterministic CPU experiment calls your submitted function. The chart displays measured optimization, retrieval, or grouping behavior; inspect its metrics alongside the trace. Synthetic experiments do not reproduce paper benchmark scores.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Read the cited mechanism, then extend the isolated kernel to the paper’s complete architecture and data pipeline. The exercise fixes a narrow, testable contract; its teaching simplifications are stated above.

# InternVL3 variable visual position increments — Solution

The recurrence depends on the current token’s modality and equals a prefix sum of increments minus one. Use one delta per image and never reset at image or text boundaries. Delta gradients count how many subsequent prefixes include each visual token. Delta one recovers positions 0 through L-1; a first visual token starts at delta-1 under the explicit origin.

$$
p_i=-1+\sum_{j=0}^{i}\left[(1-v_j)+v_j\delta_{\operatorname{image}(j)}\right].
$$

The reference implementation follows the declared layout and reduction:

```python
def variable_visual_positions(visual: Tensor, image_ids: Tensor, deltas: Tensor) -> Tensor:
    _floating(deltas)
    if visual.ndim!=1 or visual.dtype!=torch.bool or image_ids.shape!=visual.shape or image_ids.dtype!=torch.long or deltas.ndim!=1 or (deltas<=0).any() or (deltas>1).any():
        raise ValueError("invalid masks, image IDs or deltas")
    if (image_ids[~visual]!=-1).any() or (image_ids[visual]<0).any() or (image_ids[visual]>=deltas.numel()).any():raise ValueError("invalid image assignment")
    increments=[]
    for is_visual,index in zip(visual.tolist(),image_ids.tolist()):
        increments.append(deltas[index] if is_visual else deltas.new_tensor(1.))
    if not increments:return deltas.new_empty((0,))
    return torch.stack(increments).cumsum(0)-1
```

- Uses ordinary integer positions for images
- Starts positions one unit too late
